_comment: Fixed inputs for the beyond-the-sphere benchmark. Committed before solver changes. Sources are given as locations; the benchmark uses the nearest mesh vertex and measures exact distance from that vertex's actual position.
_m_note: m = 1 is the solver default and the only setting that is REQUIRED to pass. m = 4 and 16 were added after the first torus run showed the default stalls (see progress log, entry 3); they are scored against the same, unchanged tolerances.

mild.note: tangential jitter, 15% of local edge length

strong.note: stress case: 40% jitter, produces slivers and non-Delaunay edges; outcome is recorded against the same tolerances but is not required to pass

face_center.note: centre of an icosahedron face (valence 6, most regular region)

worst_triangle.note: difficult source: the vertex at the smallest angle of the worst-shaped triangle of that mesh

near_x_seam.note: just left of the x = Lx ~ 0 seam

near_y_seam.note: just above the y = 0 ~ Ly seam

negative_controls.unwrapped_reference: Score the exact unwrapped (straight-line-in-rectangle) distance as if it were the solver output for the near-seam sources; it must FAIL the geodesic tolerance.
negative_controls.unstitched_mesh: Run the real solver on the same rectangle with the seam left open (no identification); it must FAIL the geodesic tolerance for near-seam sources.
negative_controls.wrong_decay: Score exp(-2 lam T) (rate doubled) as the heat amplitude; it must FAIL the decay tolerance.
